+    Prefetches same-origin links when the user signals intent (hover/pointerdown).

+    "no-prefetch" class to any other link that must never be fetched speculatively.

+      "prefetch": [{

+        "where": {

+            { "not": { "href_matches": ["/logout", "/logout/*", "/logout?*"] } },
+            { "not": { "selector_matches": ".logout-link" } },
+            { "not": { "selector_matches": ".no-prefetch" } },
